body: Residual from V1-1809 (PR #1151, CRB-V0-020). The companion writer now emits corvint-companion-bundle/3 including corvint-ruby-test-provider, but the two-build reproducibility and installed qualification of a /3 bundle are NOT_RUN until a release candidate is cut. Expected: the next RC build records two-build equality and installed qualification for /3, and the CRB-V0-020 traceability row cites it.
title: Qualify the corvint-companion-bundle/3 (with corvint-ruby-test-provider) by two-build and installed qualification
